# Instructions Index

This document provides a master index of all instruction sets available in the LightSpeed organization.

## Available Instructions

Instructions are comprehensive guides for specific workflows, patterns, and processes.

### Repository Instructions

| Instruction | Purpose | Path |
|------------|---------|------|
| Branch Naming | Branch naming strategy and conventions | `.github/instructions/branch-naming.instructions.md` |
| Coding Standards | Unified coding standards across languages | `.github/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md` |
| File Organization | Canonical file placement and structure | `.github/instructions/file-organisation.instructions.md` |
| Plugin Structure | WordPress block plugin development patterns | `.github/instructions/plugin-structure.instructions.md` |

### Implementation Guides

| Guide | Purpose | Path |
|-------|---------|------|
| Instruction Template | Template for creating new instruction files | `.github/instructions/instructions.instructions.md` |
| PR Creation Process | Guidelines for creating and managing PRs | `docs/PR_CREATION_PROCESS.md` |
| Branching Strategy | Detailed branching strategy documentation | `docs/BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md` |

## How to Use Instructions

1. Read the relevant instruction file for your task
2. Follow the specified patterns and conventions
3. Refer to examples for clarification
4. Validate your work against the checklist
